[![Open
Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues-raw/pharmaverse/teal.widgets?color=red&label=open%20issues)](https://github.com/pharmaverse/teal.widgets/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+sort%3Aupdated-desc)

This package provides various widgets for `teal` applications. Examples
include:

- `standard_layout` for a standard UI layout with output on the right
  and an encoding panel on the left
- `plot_with_settings` for a standard plot output UI with resizing and
  downloading options
- `table_with_setting` for a standard `rtables` output UI with download
  and pagination options
- `ggplot2_args` for a standard `ggplot2` output plot with graphic
  options
- `basic_table_args` for a standard `rtables` output table with graphic
  options

teal.widgets is developed by [Roche](https://roche.com),
[Appsilon](https://www.appsilon.com), and the wider open-source
community. [Roche](https://roche.com) and
[Appsilon](https://www.appsilon.com) are copyright holders of the
project, which is hosted in the [pharmaverse](https://pharmaverse.org)
GitHub organisation.

## Installation

\
[`install.packages`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/install.packages.html)`(``'teal.widgets'``)`

Alternatively, you might want to use the development version.

\
`# install.packages("pak")`\
`pak``::`[`pak`](https://pak.r-lib.org/reference/pak.html)`(``"pharmaverse/teal.widgets"``)`

## Usage

To understand how to use this package, please refer to the [package
website](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/), which provides
multiple examples of code usage.

## Getting help

If you encounter a bug or you have a feature request - please file an
issue. For questions, discussions and staying up to date, please use the
“teal” channel in the [`pharmaverse` slack
workspace](https://pharmaverse.slack.com).

## Acknowledgment

teal.widgets was created at [Roche](https://roche.com) and is developed
together with [Appsilon](https://www.appsilon.com) and the wider
open-source community. Thank you to everyone who has contributed code,
reported an issue, improved the documentation, or built a module. To get
involved, explore the [open
issues](https://github.com/pharmaverse/teal.widgets/issues) or join the
\#teal channel in the [pharmaverse
Slack](https://pharmaverse.slack.com/).

# Package index

## User interface functions

Functions providing special user-interface elements

- [`clean_brushedPoints()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/clean_brushedPoints.md)
  : Clean brushed points

- [`draggable_buckets()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/draggable_buckets.md)
  : Draggable Buckets

- [`get_dt_rows()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/get_dt_rows.md)
  :

  Map `lenghtMenu` property

- [`optionalSelectInput()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/optionalSelectInput.md)
  [`updateOptionalSelectInput()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/optionalSelectInput.md)
  :

  Wrapper for `pickerInput`

- [`optionalSliderInput()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/optionalSliderInput.md)
  : Optional Slider Input Widget

- [`optionalSliderInputValMinMax()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/optionalSliderInputValMinMax.md)
  : Optional Slider Input with minimal and maximal values

- [`panel_group()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/panel_group.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Panel group widget

- [`panel_item()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/panel_item.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Panel item widget

- [`plot_with_settings_ui()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/plot_with_settings.md)
  [`plot_with_settings_srv()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/plot_with_settings.md)
  : Plot-with-settings module

- [`standard_layout()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/standard_layout.md)
  : Standard UI layout

- [`table_with_settings_ui()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/table_with_settings.md)
  [`table_with_settings_srv()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/table_with_settings.md)
  :

  `table_with_settings` module

- [`white_small_well()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/white_small_well.md)
  : Small well class for HTML

- [`verbatim_popup_ui()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/verbatim_popup.md)
  [`verbatim_popup_srv()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/verbatim_popup.md)
  :

  A `shiny` module that pops up verbatim text.

- [`nested_closeable_modal()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/nested_closeable_modal.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Nested Closeable Modal Popup

## ggplot2 and basic_table arguments

Aggregation and validation of arguments

- [`basic_table_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/basic_table_args.md)
  :

  Builds a `basic_table_args` object

- [`ggplot2_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/ggplot2_args.md)
  :

  Creates `ggplot2_args` object

- [`parse_ggplot2_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/parse_ggplot2_args.md)
  :

  Parse `ggplot2_args` object into the `ggplot2` expression

- [`parse_basic_table_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/parse_basic_table_args.md)
  :

  Parses `basic_table_args` object into the `basic_table` expression

- [`resolve_basic_table_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/resolve_basic_table_args.md)
  :

  Resolves and reduces multiple `basic_table_args` objects

- [`resolve_ggplot2_args()`](https://pharmaverse.github.io/teal.widgets/reference/resolve_ggplot2_args.md)
  :

  Resolving and reducing multiple `ggplot2_args` objects
